svg.title: What kind of claim each layer is
svg.desc: The Field's four tiers of support. Machine-verified: Lean-checked results. Paper-proved: argued in the paper, not formalised. Domain readings: the theory read into a domain. Guide-invented methods: assessment methods, which the Field does not include. Only the first tier is checked by building the code.

svg.text: Machine-verified

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: Part I necessity; Part II independence in the minimal witness

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: environments; the line and construct counts. Part III results hold

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: only conditionally on their stated hypotheses.

svg.text: Paper-proved

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: Argument in the paper, or in the standard literature it relies on, not

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: formalised in Lean. Main example: the reduction from the minimal

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: environment to any larger environment with the same difficulty.

svg.text: Domain readings

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: The theory read into a domain or into plain language: what the

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: definitions mean, business decision-making inside Class C, the

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: mapping of methodologies to the primitives, error theory.

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: better arguments.

svg.text: Guide-invented

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: methods

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: Methods devised for carrying out an assessment, such as how

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: evidence is gathered and weighed. None appear in the Field's

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: pages, which state criteria and not methods.

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: The tier does not apply to the Field's

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', Tinos, 'Liberation Serif', Times, serif

svg.text: pages.
